title: Sequence-form known-type M_SP_NA_1 with two elements
purpose: Cover valid sequence-form VSQ parsing with a documented known TypeID and two data elements, using base IOA semantics consistent with sequence form.
expected_behavior: A robust implementation should parse a valid sequence-form ASDU for TypeID 1 with count 2, one base IOA, and two element bytes, then process or reject it semantically without boundary errors.
constraints_preserved: TypeID 1 is a documented IEC 60870 monitoring type
VSQ 0x82 sets sequence flag and count 2
Sequence form still preserves documented ASDU header ordering
Only one base information object address is encoded for the sequence-form ASDU
Two element payload octets follow the base IOA
APDU length 0x0e exactly matches 4 APCI bytes plus 10 ASDU bytes
issue_safety_notes: Intentionally avoids the historical missing-base-IOA and oversized-count patterns by keeping count small and body length sufficient.
